name: TooltipPreview
description: A static tooltip bubble for documentation and screenshots. Same classes, no behaviour.
signature: ({ content, shortcut, side }: { content: ReactNode; shortcut?: string; side?: "top" | "bottom"; }): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: content
props.description: Content rendered by this slot or overlay.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keyboard shortcut shown with the control, using the host platform’s modifier keys.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred side of the anchor; collision handling may choose another side.
